title: Measuring the Checker: Mutation Analysis for GPU-Kernel Benchmark Oracles
abstract: arXiv:2609.22220v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Benchmarks for LLM-generated GPU kernels decide correctness with a few random inputs and a loose floating-point tolerance, and their verdicts now feed leaderboards and reinforcement-learning rewards. Recent work agrees these checkers are weak and patches them by hand---extra input distributions, fuzzing recipes, tighter tolerances---with no way to \emph{measure} whether any patch suffices. We introduce mutation analysis as an adequacy metric for kernel-benchmark oracles: deterministic rules inject 10{,}303 compilable faults into verified CUDA implementations of 188 KernelBench problems, 7{,}384 of them with an independent kill witness; any test protocol is scored by the fraction it detects. The official check misses \textbf{one in six} witnessed faults (16.9%), deterministically, and the misses are skewed by family: 8.7% of arithmetic faults escape, but 78.6% of precision faults do. translated_title: 测量检查器：面向GPU内核基准测试判定器的变异分析
translated_abstract: 针对LLM生成的GPU内核的基准测试，仅用少量随机输入和宽松的浮点容差来判定正确性，而这些判定结果如今被用于排行榜和强化学习奖励。近期研究一致认为这些检查器过于薄弱，并采用手工方式修补——增加输入分布、模糊测试方案、收紧容差——但没有任何方法可以衡量这些修补是否足够。我们引入变异分析作为内核基准测试判定器的充分性度量：通过确定性规则向188个KernelBench问题的经验证的CUDA实现中注入10,303个可编译故障，其中7,384个带有独立的“杀死见证”；任何测试协议都按其检测到的故障比例进行评分。官方检查确定性地漏掉了六分之一的见证故障（16.9%），且漏检在不同故障类别间分布不均：8.7%的算术类故障逃过检测，而精度类故障的漏检率高达78.6%。该度量解释了为什么（容差盲区不断扩大……
tldr: 该论文首次提出将变异分析作为GPU内核基准测试判定器的充分性度量，通过向188个KernelBench问题注入10,303个可编译故障来量化检查器的检测能力，发现官方检查漏检了16.9%的故障，其中精度类故障漏检率高达78.6%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces mutation analysis as an adequacy metric for GPU-kernel benchmark oracles, injecting 10,303 compilable faults into 188 KernelBench problems and showing that the official checker deterministically misses 16.9% of witnessed faults, with precision faults escaping detection at a rate of 78.6%.
